entities.name: Mikaeus Cecani
entities.description: Lunarch of the Church of Avacyn, its highest-ranking human, murdered by Geralf and later raised as a zombie by Liliana.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: Innistrad's church whose faith empowers Inquisitors and Cathars.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel imprisoned in the Helvault after dueling Griselbrand; object of the church's faith.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: Demon who dueled Avacyn and was imprisoned with her.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: Stitcher who besieged Thraben with his sister Gisa and killed Mikaeus.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: Geralf's sister, who led ghouls in the siege.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Appointed supreme commander of Thraben's forces.

entities.name: Bishop Alwin
entities.description: Bishop who decreed Mikaeus be interred quietly to preserve faith.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Necromancer planeswalker who raised Mikaeus as a zombie to learn where Griselbrand was and to destroy the Helvault.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: City led by Mikaeus, besieged by Geralf and Gisa.

entities.name: Siege of Thraben
entities.description: Undead assault on Thraben by Geralf and Gisa.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Prison holding Avacyn and Griselbrand, destroyed in the Sundering.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane where the Church of Avacyn operates.

events.summary: Mikaeus witnesses the duel of Avacyn and Griselbrand and their imprisonment, swearing the witnesses to secrecy.
events.quote: those present (including the Lunarch himself) chose to swear themselves to secrecy

events.summary: Mikaeus spends his days reassuring the populace that Avacyn is still among them, which is a lie.
events.quote: Mikaeus would spend his days reassuring the populace that all is well

events.summary: Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben; Mikaeus appoints Thalia supreme commander after Luthor is found dead.
events.quote: he appointed Thalia as the supreme commander of the city's forces

events.summary: Geralf sneaks behind the defenses and stabs Mikaeus with a letter opener, carving out his heart.
events.quote: Geralf assaulted him with a letter opener, fatally stabbing the Lunarch

events.summary: Bishop Alwin decrees Mikaeus be interred secretly to protect faith.
events.quote: decreed that Mikaeus would be interred into the tomb of the Lunarchs unceremoniously

events.summary: Liliana raises Mikaeus as a zombie, forces him to reveal the Helvault's secrets, then goes to perform the Sundering.
events.quote: Liliana raised Mikaeus as a zombie

relations.quote: He held the title of Lunarch, the highest rank within the church of Avacyn a human can attain.
Geralf assaulted him with a letter opener, fatally stabbing the Lunarch
The stitcher Geralf and his sister Gisa

relations.note: raised him as a zombie to use against the Helvault
relations.quote: Liliana raised Mikaeus as a zombie to destroy all that he fought so hard to protect in life
